 Jefferies is creating a Technology Innovation Hub in Pune, a greenfield opportunity to build the systems that power global markets. As our first India technology center, this hub brings together hands on builders who engineer the platforms behind Jefferies’ growth across capital markets, investment banking, and institutional securities. From cloud and data to AI, risk, and core business technologies, teams in Pune will lead high impact work with a global mandate.
   

  

**IT Equities Technology**
 Jefferies’ Equities Technology team builds and runs global, real\-time trading and risk platforms across the full equities product spectrum—cash equities, portfolio/algo trading, central risk books, listed \& OTC derivatives, convertibles, swaps, and ETF/basket trading. The team supports front\-office workflows end\-to\-end, including order management, quantitative trading, real\-time position and risk, AI/ML analytics, trade lifecycle processing, and regulatory/customer reporting.
   

  

 Operating in a 24x7 follow\-the\-sun model across major trading hubs, the India Technology Innovation Hub will be a core engineering center working closely with New York, London, Hong Kong, and other regions to build and enhance high\-performance, scalable systems using technologies such as Python, Java, C\+\+/C\#, cloud, modern visualization, low\-latency messaging, and in\-memory data stores.

 Jefferies’ Equities – Prime Services Technology team is seeking a technically strong and motivated Java Developer to join the Securities Finance technology group in Pune. This role will focus on the design, development, enhancement, and support of strategic trading and servicing systems used by a global Securities Finance user base. You will collaborate closely with cross\-regional technology teams in Hong Kong, London, and New York to build foundational and functional components of the Securities Finance product suite.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Develop and enhance applications and services using Java and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot preferred).
* Design, build, test, deploy, and support core Securities Finance components with a focus on scalability, performance, and resilience.
* Contribute to building distributed systems and enterprise\-grade services (APIs, messaging, batch/stream processing as applicable).
* Work with global teams to deliver features, fixes, and platform improvements across time zones.
* Participate in code reviews, unit/integration testing, and release activities.
* Diagnose production issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and implement sustainable fixes.
* Continuously improve architecture, engineering practices, automation, and observability.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of hands\-on development experience with Core Java and Spring frameworks.
* Experience delivering distributed systems and enterprise\-grade applications in production.
* Strong knowledge of SQL; experience with Redis and Kafka.
* Familiarity with AWS services such as EKS, EC2, S3, SQS, and SNS.
* Experience with SDLC and tooling including Jira, Bitbucket, and Bamboo.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development; proficiency using GitHub Copilot to improve productivity and code quality.


**Preferred Qualifications (Good To Have)**
* Experience with Python development.
* Familiarity with Airflow, Snowflake, and AWS QuickSight.
* Exposure to financial services, Securities Finance, Prime Services, or trading systems.


**About Us**
 Jefferies is a leading global, full\-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.
   

  

 At Jefferies, we believe that diversity fosters creativity, innovation and thought leadership through the infusion of new ideas and perspectives. We have made a commitment to building a culture that provides opportunities for all employees regardless of our differences and supports a workforce that is reflective of the communities where we work and live. description:
**Short description: Build and run the integrations, pipelines, automations, and internal tools that connect Mindtickle's business systems — Salesforce, NetSuite, HRMS, Slack,** 
 and Google Cloud. You take defined requirements and own the technical path end\-to\-end: design, build, ship, and keep it running.
 



  





**About the team, Business Technology \& Security runs the systems, automation,** 
 and security behind how Mindtickle operates.
 **Business Systems** 
 is its build engine — the team that turns requirements from GTM, Finance, People Success, IT, Legal and Security into shipped systems: integrations, data pipelines, automations, internal tools and agents.
 



 We are a small team. You will not be part of a traditional engineering squad with sprints and Scrum ceremonies. You will operate independently, usually owning a problem from a defined requirement through to a deployed, monitored solution — and then continuing to own it.
 



**The role:** 
 You are the engineer on the team. When a system needs to talk to another system, when a manual process needs to become an automated one, when a tool needs to exist and doesn't — you build it.
 



 Requirements come to you defined. The Product Manager and Business Systems Analyst own the business problem, the stakeholders, and the question of whether we should do it at all.
 **The technical path is entirely yours** 
 — how it's designed, what it's built on, how it's tested, how it fails safely, and how it's supported once it's live.
 



**What you'll own: Building — about half your time,** 
 Integrations between business systems. Data pipelines. Automations that remove manual work from Finance, People Success, IT, Security, and GTM. Internal tools and lightweight services. AI\-backed workflows and agents where they are the right answer, and conventional code where they are not.
 



**Running it — about a fifth of your time.** 
 You inherit a set of automations already in production and become their owner. Monitoring, alerting, incident response, and the unglamorous work of making inherited systems observable and documented. Nothing you build gets handed to someone else to support.
 



**Technical evaluation — about 15%.** 
 When the team is deciding whether to build or buy, or whether a vendor's API can actually do what the demo claimed, you build the prototype that answers it. Deep technical spikes, integration feasibility, and performance and security reality\-checks — against a requirement that the Product Manager and Analyst have already defined.
 



**Migrations — about 15%** 
 Data migration, field mapping, cutover scripts, and system replacements as we move platforms.
 



**The shape of a typical week: Daily** 
 — Writing Python with Claude Code. Reading vendor API documentation. Wiring REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks, and event\-driven flows. Debugging a sync that silently dropped records. Deploying to Cloud Run.
 



**Weekly** 
 — Shipping an increment and demoing it. Working through requirements with the Product Manager and Analyst. Triaging what broke.
 



**Monthly** 
 — One meaningful capability live in production, with monitoring, a runbook, and documentation good enough that someone else could pick it up.
 



**Stack** 
 Python · Google Apps Script · Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud Scheduler, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Firestore, Cloud Storage, Compute Engine) · REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and service\-account authentication · Claude Code and modern AI tooling as a primary way of working · Git and CI/CD
 



 Business systems you will integrate with: Salesforce, NetSuite, HRMS, Slack, Google Workspace, and the wider SaaS estate.
 



  





**What we're looking for.** 
 We care about what you have built and kept alive, not the tools listed on your CV.
 


* **2–4 years** 
 building software, integrations or automations in a professional environment
* **Strong Python** 
 , and real fluency with APIs — authentication, rate limits, retries, idempotency, pagination, webhooks, and event\-driven patterns
* **You have built integrations against SaaS APIs, not only configured them through consoles or drag\-and\-drop integration platforms**
* **Hands\-on cloud experience** 
 (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure is fine) with a working understanding of how to compose services rather than follow a tutorial
* **End\-to\-end ownership you can point to** 
 — a system you designed, built, shipped and then operated. Something that broke in production and you fixed it.
* **Debugging across system boundaries** 
 — when two systems disagree about the same record, you can work out why
* **Testing and verification instinct** 
 — you know your output is correct because you measured it, not because it ran without erroring
* **Fast on unfamiliar ground** 
 — you have picked up a stack you didn't know and shipped it. This matters more to us than prior exposure to any specific technology.
* **Clear written communication** 
 — design notes, runbooks, and documentation are part of the job, not an afterthought
* **Nice to have** 
 Building AI agents, tool\-use, and agentic workflows; MCP servers
* Exposure to business systems — CRM, ERP, HRIS, ITSM — and the SaaS ecosystem around them
* Data and pipeline work (BigQuery, ETL/ELT)
* Infrastructure\-as\-code

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
We’re an early\-stage, US\-based AI startup building a 0→1 AI\-native software platform.
 



 We’re currently operating in stealth and are looking for an exceptional senior engineer to join our small team in Pune. You’ll work directly with the founders and have meaningful influence over the product, architecture, and engineering practices from an early stage.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on role for someone who wants to build, own, and shape a product.
 



  





**What you’ll own** 




  





 You’ll take meaningful parts of the product from idea to production: shaping technical approaches, making architecture decisions, writing production code, testing, deploying, observing, and continuously improving what you ship.
 



 You’ll work across Python, TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, building both the core application and the AI\-powered workflows behind it.
 



 You’ll help us build production\-grade AI systems. That includes LLM orchestration, structured outputs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, multi\-step AI workflows, evaluations, guardrails, security and privacy controls, observability, failure handling, and cost/performance optimization.
 



 You’ll make thoughtful decisions about model selection, prompt and context design, token usage, latency, quality, and cost, and understand when techniques such as retrieval, model routing, caching, fine\-tuning, or workflow orchestration are appropriate for a production system.
 



 You’ll design and operate AI workflows involving sequential and parallel stages, dependencies, retries, validation, and failure recovery, while recognizing when a simpler deterministic solution is the better engineering choice.
 



 You’ll work directly with the founders to turn product ideas and customer learning into software, while helping establish the technical standards and engineering practices of a growing team.
 



  





**What we’re looking for** 




  




* 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial experience owning and shipping production applications end\-to\-end.
* You have personally shipped AI/LLM\-powered products or features to production that were used by real users.
* Strong Python expertise is required. You should be comfortable designing and building production systems in Python.
* Strong hands\-on experience with TypeScript/JavaScript, React or Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL or comparable relational databases.
* Practical experience building production AI/LLM systems using capabilities such as RAG, structured outputs, tool/function calling, multi\-step workflow orchestration, evaluations, guardrails, and observability.
* Experience making production decisions around model choice, prompt and context design, token usage, latency, quality, and cost.
* Understanding of retrieval, model routing, caching, fine\-tuning, and orchestration patterns, including the judgment to determine when each is and is not appropriate.
* Strong fundamentals in application security, authentication/authorization, API design, data modeling, testing, observability, privacy, and production reliability.
* Strong architecture and engineering judgment. You can take ambiguous product problems, reason through technical trade\-offs, and independently turn them into well\-engineered software.
* A strong product mindset. You care about what users need and why we’re building something, not just how to implement it.
* Deep technical curiosity. You actively keep up with advances in AI, developer tooling, frameworks, infrastructure, and software engineering and have the judgment to distinguish genuinely useful advances from hype.



  





**You might be a great fit if** 




  





 You’re the kind of engineer who experiments with a new model, framework, architecture, or development tool because you want to understand what it makes possible.
 



 You enjoy moving between product thinking, architecture, and implementation. You’re comfortable making decisions when the answer isn’t obvious, and equally comfortable changing direction when the evidence says you should.
 



 You value speed, but not at the expense of building something brittle. You know when to keep things simple, when to invest in stronger foundations, and how to make those trade\-offs explicit.
 



 When building with AI, you naturally ask: How do we know this works? How does it fail? How do we evaluate it? How do we keep user data safe? What should happen when the model gets it wrong?
 



  





 And above all, you still want to be a hands\-on builder.
 



  





**Why join now** 




  





 You’ll join early enough to have real influence over the product and technical foundation of the company while working directly with the founders.
 



 As the engineering team grows, this role has the opportunity to expand into technical leadership for someone who demonstrates the engineering judgment, ownership, and leadership ability to take on that responsibility.
 



 Location: Pune, India
 



 Employment: Full\-time
 



 Compensation: ₹45–55 LPA, depending on experience and fit.
 



  





 We’re intentionally keeping the company in stealth while we build. We’ll share significantly more about the product, founders, and company during the interview process.
 



  





**Application question** 




 Along with your application, please briefly describe one AI/LLM\-powered product or feature you personally helped ship to production and that was used by real users.
 



 In approximately 200\-400 words, tell us:
 


* What did the product or feature do?
* What did you personally own or build?
* What was the most challenging technical or product problem you encountered, and how did you approach it?
* How did you evaluate whether the AI behavior was working as intended?



  





 Please focus on your own contribution and decisions, rather than describing the work of the broader team. Please do not share any confidential information, proprietary code, customer names, or other sensitive details.

description:

**About SIG**
 Strata Information Group (SIG) is a US\-based leader in higher\-education technology consulting. We help colleges and universities modernize the systems that run their institutions — student information, HR, and finance — through ERP/SIS implementation, integration, digital transformation, CRM, and cybersecurity work.
   

  

 We are building our first engineering Center of Excellence in Pune. This is a founding\-team role. You will not be joining a large delivery pool with a fixed process; you will help set how this team builds.
   

  

**The Role**
 This is a hands\-on SQL and reporting role for someone who enjoys working with complex data and transforming business requirements into meaningful reports, dashboards, and data solutions.
   

  

 You will work across large Oracle and PostgreSQL environments, designing data models, building reporting solutions, and supporting data warehouses that enable institutional decision\-making. While the role includes client interaction, the primary focus is on data analysis, SQL development, and business intelligence.
   

  

 We are not looking for someone who has simply used SQL. We want a BI professional who can independently analyze complex schemas, build robust reporting solutions, and translate business requirements into trusted data products. Higher education experience is not required;
 **strong SQL, data modeling, and reporting expertise** 
 are.
   

  

**APIs Are the Core of This Work**
 If there is one thing to take from this description, it is this: your primary skill is working with APIs.
   

  

 Ellucian exposes a very large API surface across its student, HR, and finance platforms. A significant part of the job is knowing that catalog — reading a business requirement, working out which APIs actually serve that function, understanding what each one returns and what it does not, and then writing the code that meets the requirement. Nobody hands you a mapping from business need to endpoint. You build that understanding, and it becomes some of the most valuable knowledge you carry.
   

  

 The second half is API security. These APIs move student records, employee data, and financial transactions. You need to understand authentication and authorization flows, how tokens and scopes work, and how to request only the access an integration genuinely needs. Getting this wrong is not a bug — it is a data exposure.
   

  

*We are looking for depth here, not familiarity. Someone who has run a few SELECT statements will struggle. Someone who has written, tuned, and debugged complex SQL against real schemas and designed the models behind it will do well.*
**What You Will Do**
* Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries in Oracle and PostgreSQL.
* Translate reporting requirements into reports, dashboards, and data extracts.
* Design and maintain data models, data warehouses, and ETL/data integration processes.
* Develop BI solutions using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, or similar platforms.
* Validate and reconcile data across multiple systems and large relational datasets.
* Partner with clients and stakeholders to gather requirements, present solutions, and support delivery.
* Leverage AI\-assisted development tools to improve productivity and solution quality.


**Required Qualifications**
* 4–7 years of experience in Business Intelligence, SQL development, reporting, data engineering, or related fields.
* Advanced SQL expertise, including query optimization, performance tuning, indexing, and execution plans.
* Experience with Oracle SQL and/or PostgreSQL.
* Strong data modeling experience, including normalized (3NF) and dimensional/star schema design.
* Experience building or supporting data warehouses and ETL/data integration processes.
* Hands\-on experience with BI and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Cognos, or similar.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to work independently.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with cloud data platforms and modern ETL/ELT tools.
* Experience using AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar in a professional environment.
* Experience supporting ERP, SIS, HRMS, or Finance systems.
* Prior exposure to Higher Education technology or Ellucian solutions (Banner, Colleague, ODS, EDW) is a plus, but not required.


*What we need from you is the ability to absorb a new domain fast and start contributing inside two months.*
**Working Hours**
 Flexible schedule with a Tuesday \- Thursday overlap requirement of 3–4 hours with US Eastern morning, 2:00 \- 10:00 PM IST. Outside that overlap window, you manage your own hours. We care about what you deliver, not when you are logged in.
   

  

**Who Does Well Here**
* You are self\-driven. You unblock yourself, ask sharp questions, and do not wait to be assigned work.
* You are curious about the tools that make you faster, and you actually try them.
* You are comfortable being early. This team is being built now, and the process is not fully written.
* You can talk to a non\-technical client and explain what you built without making them feel lost.

* Support model implementation and productionization, including translating model methodology into technical/business rules where required.

 To monitor customer accounts for suspicious/fraudulent activities and take appropriate action when required.

description:
**Technology**
 Join a small, high\-impact engineering team in Citi Markets Technology building the data foundation for greenfield Generative AI products across asset classes. We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer who combines deep Python expertise with strong engineering judgement and a practical understanding of how to build reliable, high\-performance data platforms.
   

  

 The role goes beyond constructing ETL pipelines. You will help define how billions of records from diverse Markets data sources are collected, validated, transformed, governed, and made available to production AI applications with consistently low retrieval latency.
   

  

 If you want to work on ambitious data engineering problems, shape a platform from the ground up, and help define how data is engineered for production AI in Markets, this is the role for you.
   

  

**The Team**
 We are a fast\-moving team specialising in Generative AI within Markets Technology. We build greenfield products that span multiple asset classes and solve real business problems using modern AI and data engineering approaches.
   

  

 Our applications depend on a robust and well\-designed data foundation. That means creating pipelines and serving layers that can process billions of records while preserving data quality, provenance, security, and operational reliability.
   

  

 The team is still small enough for every engineer to have genuine influence. Data engineering is a core part of the product architecture, not a downstream support function.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Vice President in the team, you will be a hands\-on senior engineer responsible for designing and building the data foundation for greenfield Generative AI products across Markets, including our conversational AI platform.
   

  

 You will develop production\-grade data pipelines and services, primarily using Python, to ingest, validate, transform, enrich, and serve data from a wide range of internal and external sources. You will help create a curated, high\-performance data\-serving layer that enables low\-latency retrieval by our AI and application services.
   

  

 You will contribute directly to code while also shaping architecture, engineering standards, data models, quality controls, and operational practices. We are looking for someone who can make pragmatic technology choices, challenge assumptions, and take long\-term ownership of the platform.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Design, build, and evolve the data architecture supporting Generative AI products across Markets
* Develop scalable Python pipelines that ingest, validate, transform, enrich, and integrate billions of records from diverse sources
* Build curated, queryable datasets and high\-performance serving layers for low\-latency application access
* Design and optimise the application’s data storage strategies, initially centred on PostgreSQL and Parquet
* Select suitable processing approaches for each workload, from efficient in\-process and columnar processing to distributed frameworks where required
* Optimise ingestion, transformation, storage, indexing, and query performance
* Establish robust controls for data quality, reconciliation, lineage, schema evolution, idempotency, and recovery
* Build production observability into data pipelines, including metrics, logging, alerting, and operational diagnostics
* Design solutions that respect data classification, entitlements, access controls, and security requirements
* Contribute directly to code, architecture reviews, technical standards, and the wider engineering direction of the team
* Build automated tests and CI/CD pipelines that enable reliable and repeatable delivery
* Collaborate closely with AI engineers, software engineers, architects, product partners, and Markets stakeholders
* Use AI\-assisted engineering tools, including Devin and GitHub Copilot, to improve development quality and productivity


**What We’re Looking For**
* Extensive hands\-on experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a closely related discipline
* Deep practical expertise in Python and the ability to build maintainable, production\-grade software
* A proven track record of designing and delivering large\-scale data platforms or data\-intensive applications
* Strong SQL skills and extensive experience with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL
* Experience with data modelling, indexing, partitioning, query optimisation, and database performance tuning
* Strong knowledge of the Python data ecosystem, including libraries such as pandas, PyArrow, SQLAlchemy, and NumPy
* Practical experience working with columnar formats such as Apache Parquet and selecting efficient storage and serialisation strategies
* Experience processing large\-scale datasets using technologies such as Apache Spark, Dask, Polars, or equivalent frameworks
* Strong understanding of ETL and ELT architecture, including incremental processing, idempotency, failure recovery, and schema evolution
* Experience implementing automated data quality controls, reconciliation, lineage, monitoring, and operational alerting
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including design, testing, maintainability, code review, and CI/CD
* Experience deploying and operating services on container platforms such as Kubernetes or OpenShift
* Understanding of data governance and security practices, including encryption, masking, classification, entitlements, and fine\-grained access control
* The ability to operate in ambiguity, take ownership, and influence the technical direction of a product
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach to engineering


**What Makes This Role Different**
 This is not a role focused on maintaining legacy ETL jobs or moving data between systems without understanding how it will be used.
   

  

 You will help build the data foundation of a new generation of AI products in Markets. The engineering challenges include integrating complex datasets, processing billions of records, delivering consistently low retrieval latency, and meeting the quality, security, and reliability standards expected of production financial systems.
   

  

 The role offers the opportunity to influence the architecture from an early stage, work closely with AI and application engineers, and take genuine ownership of a platform that is central to the product.
